title: On Donating the whole collection to the school
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：donate　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 donate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the observer ① donated the whole collection to the school twice over, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the observer ② donates the whole collection to the school year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ donate the whole collection to the school at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ donated the whole collection to the school before — a line in the log for November 1955 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Donating the whole collection to the school twice over, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ donate blood three times that year year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Donate blood three times that year at once and never mention it again.

By 1968 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new assistant from the next observatory ⑧ donates blood three times that year twice over every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the dome, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ donated the whole collection to the school again when nobody else would.

⑩ To donate the whole collection to the school, my mother said in 1973, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the observatory remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the observatory forgets, somebody donates the whole collection to the school year after year again and somebody must donate the whole collection to the school twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 捐赠（一般过去式 donated the whole collection to the school：1961 年观测员头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 捐赠（一般现在 donates the whole collection to the school：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 捐赠（不定式 to donate the whole collection to the school：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 捐赠（过去完成时 had donated the whole collection to the school：1955 年十一月的观测记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 捐赠（动名词 donating the whole collection to the school 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 献出（donate blood three times that year：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去献出那年献了三次血）
G. v. 献出（donate blood three times that year：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 捐赠（后段两处：新来的助手照例 donates blood three times that year，而母亲又一次 donated the whole collection to the school）

answers.why: donate 意为“捐赠”，1961 年观测员来回两遍捐赠把全部收藏捐给学堂，那是观测站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 donated。
donate 意为“捐赠”，自那以后观测员年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 donates。
donate 意为“捐赠”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯捐赠把全部收藏捐给学堂”，此处为不定式 to donate the whole collection to the school。
donate 意为“捐赠”，观测记录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1968 年之前就有人捐赠过，故用过去完成时 had donated。
donate 意为“捐赠”，观测员说“捐赠把全部收藏捐给学堂这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 donating the whole collection to the school 作主语。
donate 意为“献出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去献出那年献了三次血”，should ever 之后用原形 donate blood three times that year。
donate 意为“献出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻献出那年献了三次血（donate blood three times that year at once），以后再也不要提起。
donate 意为“捐赠”，新来的助手每个夜晚都照例献出那年献了三次血，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 donates。
donate 意为“捐赠”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍捐赠把全部收藏捐给学堂，用一般过去式 donated 叙述。
donate 意为“捐赠”，结尾那句是母亲 1973 年的话：要捐赠把全部收藏捐给学堂，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和观测站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 donate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the observer donated the whole collection to the school twice over, and nobody in the observatory forgot it.
Even now the observer donates the whole collection to the school year after year whenever the observatory asks.
Donating the whole collection to the school twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever donate blood three times that year year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next observatory donates blood three times that year twice over every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother donated the whole collection to the school again, and the observatory remembered that half.
